text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Crayfish GET!! Dried squid really is the best bait there is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおーっ！　
ザリガニゲットーっ！！
やっぱりエサは
スルメがさいきょーだよね！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Look, look, Sono-chan! Iroha... caught a crayfish!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て見て
苑ちゃん！
いろは、
ザリガニ捕ったよーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Uwaah, did you really just grab that thing with your hands...? ...No, it's scary, very scary. Don't bring it over here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うお、
あんたよく素手でいけんね？
……いや怖い怖い。
こっち持って来なくていいから。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Toh, the local supermarket timed sale is about to start. C'mon Iroha, it's about time we head home. Let the crayfish go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、
そろそろタイムセール始まんじゃん。
いろは帰るよ。
ザリガニ返してき。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Okaaaaay! See you later, crayfi-... Hm? What's this? A bottle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーいっ！
じゃあまたねザリガニさー……
……ん？　
なんだろこれ、
瓶？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, making dinner today's going to be such a pain. Hey, Iroha... having leftovers for dinner is going to be fine, right? ...Wait, oi. What did you pick up this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
今日ご飯作るのめんどいな。
ねーいろは、
今日お惣菜でいいよねー……
っておい。
今度は何拾ってきたー？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Look, look! This thing floated by just now! Hey, hey, this is... a message in a bottle, right!? Wow, so cool, I've never seen this before! I wanna read it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て見て！　
これさっきそこに流れてきたんだ～！
ねね、
これって
ボトルメールってやつだよね！？
すごい、
初めて見たー！　
読みたーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Don't just say you want to read it... after having already opened it on your own. Hah... Wait, is this in English?
text_block_list.orig_text:
読みたーい
って……
勝手に開けてるし。
はあ……
……って、
待ってこれ英語？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did it drift here from overseas!? Awesome! It's... international intercultural exchange!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
外国から流れてきたのかなっ！？
すごーいっ！　
コクサイイブンカコーリューだっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, there's no way. This is a river. Even if it came from upstream, it'd still be Japan. ...Still, well, I guess I'm kind of interested now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやないだろ、
ここ川だぞ。
上流だって日本だわ。
……でもま、
ちょっと興味湧くね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Sono-chan, do you understand English!? Iroha does! HOW OLD ARE YOU?
text_block_list.orig_text:
苑ちゃん英語分かる！？
いろは分かるよ！
はう、
おーるど、
あーゆー？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Why are you asking me my age? Trying to pick a fight? Seriously, I can speak English easily. By using this translation app, that is. ...Mmm, let's see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで年齢聞いてきた？　
けんか売ってる？
ったく、
英語くらい余裕よ。
この翻訳アプリを使えばね。
……えーと、
なになに？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Dear. My beloved prince whom I have yet to meet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──Dear.
まだ見ぬ愛しの王子さま。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, my Destined Prince. I am here. Though we have never met, I always see your face in my dreams. I'm sure I am smiling in your dreams too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
王子さま。
私はここよ。
出会ったことはないけれど、
いつもあなたの面影を夢に見る。
きっとあなたの夢の中でも、
私がほほ笑んでるわよね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Your eyes, your eyelashes. Your slender fingers that would gently brush against me. Just imagining it makes my heart flutter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
愛するあなたのその目を、
まつげを。
私を優しくなでるその細い指先を。
思い描いて、
私は胸を高鳴らせるわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, my Destined Prince, I'm right here. Please find me, catch me. I always dream of that day. One day, surely... "DREAMS COME TRUE".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
王子さま、
私はここよ。
早く私を見つけて、
捕まえて。
その日をいつも夢見てる。
いつか、
きっと。
”夢は叶う”。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: From: Amasaka Louise Mari...
text_block_list.orig_text:
From.
天坂・
ルイズ・
真璃──

text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, WAAAAAAAIIIIIITTTT!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待て待て待て待て待て～～～いっっ！！

text_block_list.text: Wha-... Please give that back! Geez... Why'd it have to get found before it even made it to the ocean?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
返してください！
もう……
何で海に出る前に止まっちゃうわけ！？

text_block_list.text: U-Umm... This letter... did you read it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの
これ……
読みました？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: It's nice to finally meet you, Mari-chan. I'm your Destined Prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっと会えたね
真璃ちゃん。
おれが運命の王子さまだよ。

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: NOT ONLY YOU READ IT, YOU'RE ALSO MESSING WITH ME!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 見られた上にいじられてるっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, somehow, I'm sorry. We didn't really mean anything bad, so please forgive us. ...Wait, you're Amasaka-san, who moved in next door, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
なんかごめん。
悪気は……
たぶんないから許してやって。
ってかあなた、
隣に引っ越してきた天坂さんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: Wha-... Come to think of it, I do recall seeing you two before. Huh...? So my neighbors read that letter?! This sucks...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……っ、
そういえば見覚えが。
え……
お隣さんに見られちゃった！？
最悪だわ……！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Woooow, Onee-san you're the Mari-chan I've heard so much about?! A super pretty half-Japanese girl... you're just like the rumors said!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあっ、
おねーさんが噂の真璃ちゃん！？
ハーフでとっても美人な女の子って、
評判通りだね！

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? There were such rumors? To say that I'm beautiful... Hehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え、
そんな噂が？
美人だって……
ふふふ♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: She got over all that way too fast... It feels like she's forgotten about her dark history of writing such a cringey poem being discovered.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一瞬で機嫌が直った……
もう激ヤバポエム見られた黒歴史は忘れてる感じだ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mari-chan! You can come hang out at Iroha's house today! I’ll show you the game I’m really into right now~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ真璃ちゃん！
今日いろはのお家に遊びに来てもいいよ！
いろはが最近はまってるゲーム、
真璃ちゃんに教えたげるっ♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And this was how the fateful encounter between Isurugi Sono, Isurugi Iroha and Amasaka Louise Mari had happened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
石動いろは、
石動苑、
そして天坂・ルイズ・真璃の３人は、
こうして運命的な出会いを果たしたのだった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe they really were like that in a past life, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんて前世もあったのかもしれない。
